papers.title_en: Beyond Better Ideas: How Human-AI Collaboration Shapes Scientific Ideas and Human Perceptions
papers.authors: Qian Chen, Saatvik Pradhan, Janice Ahn, Berk Atil, Angkai Li, Shijie Lu, Nobin Sarwar, Michael Ulis, Ruyuan Wan, Wenpeng Yin
papers.evidence: 实证研究人机协作如何影响科学创意与人类对AI的认知
papers.tldr: 人工智能参与科研构思，其影响不仅在于创意质量，还涉及评价、贡献归属与研究者认知。研究对比人机与人人团队，结合人类和大模型评审、协作来源识别及参与者调查展开分析。结果显示，人机协作在人工评分中无显著质量优势，迭代修改则持续改善质量；模型评分接近人类，却存在排序分歧及偏好人工智能辅助提案的现象。实际协作也伴随更高的有用性感知，但效率收益低于预期，提示应多维审视人工智能的科研价值。
papers.abstract_en: As AI increasingly becomes a collaborator in scientific research, its impact may extend beyond improving ideas to reshaping how they are evaluated, attributed, and perceived by humans. Yet existing research has largely examined these dimensions in isolation. We present a unified empirical study of Human-AI scientific ideation, investigating two complementary perspectives: i) how AI collaboration shapes scientific ideas and their evaluation, and ii) how firsthand collaboration reshapes human perceptions of AI. Through a shared experimental setting involving Human-AI and Human-Human research teams, human and LLM evaluators, collaboration-provenance analysis, and participant surveys, we uncover several counterintuitive findings. First, AI collaboration shows no significant advantage in human-evaluated idea quality, while iterative revision consistently improves quality. Second, AI judges can approximate human scores yet disagree on idea rankings; notably, an AI judge favors AI-assisted proposals without a corresponding advantage in human evaluations. Third, collaboration provenance remains only partially detectable, revealing substantial overlap between Human-AI and Human-Human scientific outputs. Finally, firsthand AI collaboration is associated with greater perceived usefulness but smaller efficiency gains than expected, suggesting a nuanced recalibration of human expectations. Overall, our findings challenge the notion that AI's value in scientific ideation lies primarily in producing better ideas, revealing instead its broader influence on scientific creation, evaluation, attribution, and human perceptions.

papers.title_en: Learning Personalized Memory Gating from Delayed One-Sided Feedback
papers.authors: Kaixuan Ji, Zixiang Chen, Wenting Zhao, Cheng Qian, Heng Wang, Weizhi Zhang, Jielin Qiu, Liangwei Yang, Quanquan Gu, Silvio Savarese, Shelby Heinecke, Huan Wang
papers.evidence: 为个性化语言模型智能体学习适配用户的长期记忆筛选策略。
papers.tldr: 语言模型智能体的记忆容量有限，统一的存储策略难以适应不同用户对事实的未来复用需求。论文以事实是否在后续交互中被检索并用于回答作为标签，将记忆筛选建模为具有延迟单侧反馈的上下文苹果品尝问题，提出结合离线初始化与在线个性化适应的 Warm-Start UCB。作者给出高概率遗憾上界，并在不同记忆预算和历史长度下取得优于所有基线的表现。这为利用用户交互反馈学习个性化记忆策略提供了理论与实证支持。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables language-model agents to personalize future interactions, but a finite memory bank cannot preserve every extracted fact. Existing memory gating policies are typically shared across users and therefore fail to account for user-specific patterns of future reuse. In this paper, we study memory gating at the fact level. We first propose a retrieval-based labeling strategy that labels each fact by whether it is later retrieved and incorporated into responses. We then formulate online memory gating as contextual apple tasting with delayed one-sided feedback, and propose Warm-Start UCB, which combines offline learning from existing data with online adaptation to the current user. Our theoretical analysis establishes a high-probability regret upper bound of $\tilde{O}(Tε\wedge d\sqrt{T})$ when the delay window is at most $O(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the total number of rounds, $ε$ is the initialization error, $d$ is the dimension of the feature map, and $\tilde{O}(\cdot)$ hides constant and poly-logarithmic factors. The results of our experiment demonstrate that our method outperforms all baselines under different memory budgets and history lengths, establishing it as a promising personalized memory gating policy.

papers.title_en: Conversational AI for Perceived Cognitive Decline Screening in Older Adults
papers.authors: Nikita Gautam, Moana Sargent, Kaitlyn Sievers, Ashley Sylvara, Doina Caragea, Heather Bailey, Tianjun Sun
papers.evidence: 评估对话式人工智能筛查老年人认知衰退
papers.tldr: 老年人认知下降的早期筛查受限于传统评估的人力与资源需求。研究利用聊天助手采集开放式问答，比较传统机器学习、冻结与微调的变换器及大语言模型，预测参与者自报的感知认知下降。最佳文本方案准确率为74.2%，但结构化测量模型表现更好，且测试集仅31人，结果应作描述性解读。研究表明对话文本含有相关筛查信号，但尚不能替代临床评估，仍需更大且临床多样的样本验证。
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of cognitive decline in older adults remains challenging due to the resource demands of standard neuropsychological assessments. Chatbot-based Intelligent Cognitive Assistants (ICAs) provide a scalable alternative by eliciting open-ended responses rich in linguistic, semantic, and autobiographical cues. This study evaluates whether ICA question-answer (Q/A) interviews with older adults can screen for participant-reported perceived cognitive decline and related cognitive, functional, and personality outcomes. We compare traditional machine learning, frozen transformer embeddings, fine-tuned transformers, and large language model (LLM) reasoning strategies across Global Q/A, Single Q/A confidence averaging, and Aggregated Q/A pipelines. Among text-based methods, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite (1-example-per-class, Aggregated Q/A) achieved the highest held-out test performance (0.742 accuracy, 0.739 balanced accuracy, 0.728 macro-F1). Given the small test set (n = 31), these results are interpreted descriptively. Frozen clinical transformer embeddings with a random forest head led non-LLM text methods, whereas fine-tuned models showed limited generalization. Models utilizing structured questionnaires, cognitive tasks, and personality traits outperformed text-based models in classification. Continuous regression analyses revealed modest predictive signals for AD8, FAQ, IQCODE, neuroticism, and conscientiousness. Exploratory prompt-level analyses identified both direct symptom-related and indirect autobiographical questions with strong test metrics, though sample sizes varied across prompts. These findings indicate that ICA chatbot interviews capture meaningful signals of perceived cognitive decline, supporting scalable screening research. Larger, clinically diverse cohorts with validated clinical outcomes are needed for clinical translation.

papers.title_en: Measuring undergraduate students' reliance on generative AI during problem-solving: Scale development and validation
papers.authors: Chenyu Hou, Gaoxia Zhu, Vidya Sudarshan, Fun Siong Lim, Yew Soon Ong
papers.evidence: 开发并验证衡量学生解题时如何依赖生成式人工智能的量表
papers.tldr: 复杂问题求解的结果往往难以即时判定对错，传统依赖结果的测量方式难以刻画学生如何使用生成式人工智能。研究以本科生任务后的问卷回应开发量表，先用800份回应探索因素，再用两组数据验证。量表识别出反思性、谨慎性、无思考及协作性使用四个维度，整体内部一致性系数为0.84，在两项任务中均呈现可接受的模型拟合。该工具为不直接依赖任务结果的人工智能依赖行为评估提供支持，并可辅助高校教师调整教学整合策略。
papers.abstract_en: Reliance on AI describes the behavioral patterns of when and how individuals depend on AI suggestions, and appropriate reliance patterns are necessary to achieve effective human-AI collaboration. Traditional measures often link reliance to decision-making outcomes, which may not be suitable for complex problem-solving tasks where outcomes are not binary (i.e., correct or incorrect) or immediately clear. Therefore, this study aims to develop a scale to measure undergraduate students' behaviors of using Generative AI during problem-solving tasks without directly linking them to specific outcomes. We conducted an exploratory factor analysis on 800 responses collected after students finished one problem-solving activity, which revealed four distinct factors: reflective use, cautious use, thoughtless use, and collaborative use. The overall scale has reached sufficient internal reliability (Cronbach's alpha = .84). Two confirmatory factor analyses (CFAs) were conducted to validate the factors using the remaining 730 responses from this activity and 1,173 responses from another problem-solving activity. CFA indices showed adequate model fit for data from both problem-solving tasks, suggesting that the scale can be applied to various human-AI problem-solving tasks. This study offers a validated scale to measure students' reliance behaviors in different human-AI problem-solving activities and provides implications for educators to responsively integrate Generative AI in higher education.

papers.title_en: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences
papers.authors: Jialin Li, Zhenhao Chen, Hanjun Luo, Hanan Salam
papers.evidence: 评测个人智能体记忆交互偏好及自主行动决策的能力
papers.tldr: 个人智能体即使完成任务，也可能因反复提问、过度确认或不必要的主动联系增加用户负担。论文提出MemPABench，通过跨四个月、99次会话的长期交互，测试智能体能否记住并执行随情境和时间变化的交互偏好。在四种模型骨干上评估四类记忆系统发现，检索式记忆未优于无记忆基线，文件式记忆虽提升准确率，却易将偏好用于无关情境。该基准揭示，记住偏好不等于按偏好行动，记忆检索、动态更新与行为落实仍是关键瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Personal intelligence systems are taking on increasingly complex everyday tasks, yet repeated questions, unnecessary confirmations, and unwanted outreach can turn capable assistance into interaction burden. Reducing this burden requires agents to remember how users want to be assisted. However, existing memory benchmarks focus on factual recall and personalized answers and rarely test how agents learn and act on interaction preferences. We introduce MemPABench, an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of memory in personal agents. MemPABench poses long-horizon tasks requiring agents to decide when to clarify, confirm, or act autonomously. Four grounded simulated users hold 14 preferences across work and personal contexts. Their feedback spans 99 sessions over four months, with five event-driven changes per user testing memory updates. We evaluate preference selection, delivered behavior, and sensitivity to context and preference change. Evaluating four memory systems across four LLM backbones, we find that current memory brings limited gains in preference selection. Retrieval-based systems (i.e. Mem0, MemOS, simple RAG) do not outperform No Memory, while File-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts. Our analysis shows that current memory struggles to retrieve interaction preferences and adapt to preference changes. Even with the correct preference available, overriding the agent's default interaction habits remains challenging. The environment and dataset are available at https://mempabench.com.

papers.title_en: Diagnosing Personalization Failures in Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Zhixin Lin, Dongliang Xu, Jungang Li, Shidong Pan, Jun Feng, Yanbin Sun, Jing Li, Liang Liu, Yue Yao
papers.evidence: 诊断移动界面智能体在执行过程中是否及何时遵循用户偏好
papers.tldr: 移动界面智能体不仅要完成任务，还须判断用户偏好如何改变执行策略、应在何时生效。论文提出PrefDiag-Bench，将偏好分为五类，并用1664个分阶段探针定位失败环节。在显式用户画像与行为记忆两种条件下评估11套系统，发现个性化表现明显落后于普通任务，排序与流程偏好尤其困难；最佳模型在显式画像下的流程偏好任务上仅达47.17%。研究进一步定位历史证据筛选与偏好生效时机识别两项瓶颈，为超越整体成功率的个性化诊断提供基准。
papers.abstract_en: Unlike conventional GUI agents, personalized GUI agents require user preferences to guide sequential execution over changing GUI states. This raises two challenges: determining HOW each preference should alter execution strategy and WHEN it should take effect along the interaction trajectory. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate overall task success, offering limited insight into these questions. We introduce PrefDiag-Bench with two components: (1) a categorization of preferences into five types, characterizing HOW they affect execution; and (2) a stage-wise diagnostic framework with 1,664 probes, tracing WHEN preferences should take effect and where failures occur. We evaluate eleven GUI agent systems, including end-to-end agents and agentic workflows, under two forms of user context: explicit user profiles and behavioral memory logs. Although existing agents achieve relatively high completion rates on non-personalized tasks, performance is substantially lower on preference-personalized tasks. Even the best-performing model, Seed-2.0-Pro, achieves only 47.17% on Process preferences under explicit user profiles. Agents struggle particularly with Ranking and Process preferences. Further analysis reveals two key capability bottlenecks: selecting relevant evidence from user history and recognizing when preferences should take effect during execution. Controlled interventions that explicitly provide relevant evidence improve end-to-end task success by up to 7.06%. PrefDiag-Bench offers a more systematic evaluation of GUI agents' personalization capabilities beyond overall task success. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Zhixin-L/PrefDiag-Bench.

papers.title_en: Abstract Priorities, Concrete Rewards: How Stated Preferences Relate to What People Reward in AI Responses
papers.authors: Zihan Chen, Lei Nico Zheng, Di Zhu
papers.evidence: 比较用户声明偏好与其对人工智能回答的实际评分反馈
papers.tldr: 用户声称重视的回答属性，未必就是其评分时实际奖励的特征。研究利用1396名参与者对21个大模型的29347条回答评分，对比问卷偏好、文本特征与书面反馈。声明偏好与他人感知的模型优势一致，却不对应回答文本代理指标；长短偏好的具体反馈更能解释评分差异。个人信息带来的预测提升最多仅0.13个百分点，提示个性化应区分抽象属性认知与具体奖励特征。
papers.abstract_en: AI assistants built on large language models (LLMs) are trained on human feedback and increasingly personalized to users' stated preferences. Yet how closely these preferences reflect what people reward in responses remains unclear. We compare stated and revealed preferences in the public PRISM dataset, in which 1,396 participants reported how much seven response attributes mattered to them and then rated 29,347 responses from 21 LLMs. Among responses to the same prompt, features the survey never asked about, such as response length, formatting and refusal language, were at least as strongly associated with ratings as text proxies of the surveyed attributes. Whether stated priorities matched ratings depended on how attributes were measured: participants who prioritized an attribute favoured responses from models that others perceived as strong on it, but not responses that scored higher on text proxies for it. Written feedback was more telling: participants who asked for shorter answers, even in earlier conversations, gave length less weight in their ratings, and those asking for longer answers gave it more. Their relative priorities over the surveyed attributes, however, did not predict this weight. Reasons given for choices reflected perceived attributes more than measured features. Participants also differed stably in how much they weighted several concrete features, especially length, but with a median of 6 conversations per participant, these weights were estimated poorly. The largest gain from personal information in predicting held-out choices was 0.13 percentage points, compared with 1.11 for a stronger pooled model. Stated priorities thus track perceived attributes of AI responses but say little about the concrete features that ratings reward, a distinction that matters for preference elicitation and AI personalization.

papers.title_en: ABRA: Agent-Bound UI for Human-Agent Communication beyond Chat with Reusable Views
papers.authors: Seon Gyeom Kim, Hannah Kim
papers.evidence: 设计超越聊天的共享交互界面，支持人与智能体协作
papers.tldr: 智能体虽能生成丰富的交互界面，用户表达意图却仍主要依赖聊天，形成输出与输入的不对称。论文提出智能体绑定界面，将可复用交互结构与任务语义分离，由智能体绑定并发布语义，使用户和其他智能体能够理解并操作同一界面。作者实现了框架无关的原型ABRA，展示代表性用例，并评估四个大模型智能体的画布创作、归属方后果解析及跨智能体调用能力。其贡献是让已有可视化表示成为人机双向协作媒介，但摘要未报告量化结果。
papers.abstract_en: Agents can create rich representations, yet these representations are rarely used as a medium for expressing user intent. We present Agent-Bound UI, an interaction model that separates reusable interaction structures from task-specific meanings. Agents bind task-specific meanings to interactions in reusable views and publish the resulting bindings as shared state, enabling humans and agents to understand and act on shared surfaces whose meanings vary across tasks. We implement ABRA, a framework-agnostic prototype of Agent-Bound UI, in which users and agents collaborate through chat and shared interactive canvases. We demonstrate ABRA through a representative use case and evaluate four LLM-backed agents on canvas authoring, owner-side consequence resolution, and cross-agent invocation. The code and demo video are available at https://github.com/megagonlabs/abra.

papers.title_en: Working Through Representation: Malleable Workspaces for Human-Agent Knowledge Work
papers.authors: Nan Chen, Long Ling, Luna K. Qiu, Zilong Wang, Yuqing Yang
papers.evidence: 纵向研究考察人和智能体如何协作组织并推进知识工作
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能已进入知识工作，但对话历史难以承载持续演化、指导后续行动的工作组织。论文提出“可塑工作空间”概念模型，描述人与智能体如何共同构建、修订工作表征，并据此推进工作。研究结合概念分析、58篇论文比较，以及对7名资深用户为期三个月的系统纵向研究。结果显示，现有系统更常支持局部纳入智能体输出，较少支持重组及表征之外的实质改变；该模型为以表征为中心的人机协作设计提供分析基础。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI supports knowledge work, yet conversational histories may not capture the evolving organization that guides subsequent action. We introduce the Malleable Workspace, a conceptual model of how humans and agents form and revise a Work Representation and use its organization to advance work within a wider Work Environment. We developed it iteratively through conceptual analysis, comparison of 58 papers, and the construction and three-month longitudinal study of MalleableSpace with seven experienced agent users. Systems varied in what they represented as units and relations. System-assembled context was common; more systems supported local incorporation of agent outputs than reorganization, and fewer supported consequential agent-driven changes beyond the representation. The field study showed how representational roles and organization developed in use. These observations refined the model's account of how representation-grounded action depends on and can change the Work Environment. We contribute a conceptual and analytic foundation for representation-centered human--agent design.

papers.title_en: Learning What to Ask for Tomorrow: Active Preference Acquisition for Long-Term Personalized Web Agents
papers.authors: Yiqi Wang, Zizhi Zeng, Jiaqi Zhang, Yiqun Duan, Mingkai Zheng, Taotao Cai
papers.evidence: 主动询问未来任务所需的用户偏好，并权衡询问成本与隐私披露风险。
papers.tldr: 长期服务同一用户的网页智能体，需要获取用户尚未透露的偏好，但提问会带来交互负担与隐私披露风险。论文提出主动偏好获取方法，以偏好在未来任务中的累计收益减去询问成本，决定预算内该问什么。在20项任务的评测中，34.4%的有价值缺失偏好依赖长期复用才值得询问，该方法获取其中80.3%，仅考虑当前任务的方法为5.1%。结果表明，个性化提问应依据长期复用价值，而非只看眼前收益。
papers.abstract_en: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. APA computes the counterfactual gain of each candidate preference on public task prototypes with the agent's own task solver and aggregates it by the expected reuse of each task family. We evaluate it on ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal benchmark with hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities. At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%. Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines. In our cost setting, asking about every unknown preference yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of its utility gain with 27.6% of its questions. The value of acquiring a user preference should account for its reuse across future tasks, not only its benefit to the task at hand.

papers.title_en: In-Browser Human-AI Co-Writing for Counterspeech: An Exploratory User Study of Agency, Perceived Response Quality, and Time
papers.authors: Tammy Schmidt, Luise Koch
papers.evidence: 用户研究评估人机协同写作中的能动性与内容质量
papers.tldr: 撰写反仇恨言论耗费认知与情绪资源，全自动生成又可能削弱用户的表达自主性与责任感。研究设计浏览器内协作写作工具，结合用户想法与动态检索示例，提供三个可编辑建议，并开展十人被试内探索研究。辅助回复在共情等五项指标上的描述性均分均更高，但平均写作时间从2.52增至3.88分钟。研究提示应将此类工具定位为审慎协作而非自动代写，并兼顾共情与用户表达正当愤怒的需要。
papers.abstract_en: Writing counterspeech that challenges online hate speech can be cognitively and emotionally demanding, whereas fully automated generation may weaken users' sense of voice and responsibility. We present an in-browser AI-assisted co-writing tool that enables users to contribute their own ideas and offers three editable suggestions generated by a large language model using dynamically retrieved hate speech-counterspeech examples from the Multitarget CONAN dataset. We evaluated the tool in an exploratory within-subject study with ten participants, complemented by think-aloud observations and semi-structured interviews with half of the participants. Participants wrote responses to three self-selected hate speech instances without assistance and then repeated the task with the tool. Final responses were subsequently peer-rated for empathy, non-toxicity, relevance, specificity, and persuasiveness. Participants evaluated the interface positively, and qualitative accounts linked user input, selection among alternatives, and small edits to perceived agency and responsibility. Assisted responses received higher descriptive mean ratings across all five proxies, with the largest difference for empathy. Mean composition time increased from 2.52 to 3.88 minutes. Qualitative findings further revealed a tension between empathy-oriented outputs and users' desire to express legitimate anger or direct disagreement. We contribute exploratory design guidance for treating AI-assisted counterspeech as deliberative co-writing rather than automated text production.

papers.title_en: AgentPhishing: A Benchmark of LLM Email Agents Under Adaptive Attack
papers.authors: Justin Tan, Miao Li, Ding Zhao
papers.evidence: 直接评估代用户处理邮件的计算机使用智能体所面临的钓鱼风险
papers.tldr: 邮件智能体不仅要识别钓鱼邮件，还可能执行其中的恶意请求，因此传统检测评测不足以反映其安全性。论文提出AgentPhishing基准，并用PhishOpt在固定约束和真实性要求下，针对单个智能体优化可复用的邮件生成技能，再结合说服策略分析构建通用技能。九个受测智能体中，四个的钓鱼检测率低于10%，恶意请求执行率高于45%。研究表明，安全处理既有钓鱼邮件不等于能抵御自适应攻击，评测应同时关注识别与实际行为。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents increasingly handle private information and act on users' behalf across desktop and web applications, including email. Phishing therefore poses privacy and security risks that depend not only on whether agents recognize malicious messages, but also on how they respond. Existing phishing datasets were developed primarily for conventional detection, leaving agent susceptibility to persuasive malicious requests insufficiently characterized. To expose vulnerabilities that pre-existing datasets may miss, we introduce AgentPhishing, a benchmark for evaluating whether persuasive phishing attacks can evade detection and induce LLM email agents to comply with malicious requests. We develop PhishOpt, which optimizes reusable email-generation skills against individual agents under fixed benchmark constraints and a realism constraint. We analyze the generated emails using Cialdini's persuasion principles to identify strategies associated with agent failures and use these findings to construct a universal generation skill. Our evaluation shows that agents can handle pre-existing phishing emails safely yet remain susceptible to attacks adapted to agent behavior, while in an AgentPhishing evaluation of nine agents, four exhibit phishing-detection rates below $10\%$ and malicious-request compliance rates above $45\%$. These results highlight the limits of inferring agent safety from conventional phishing evaluations and the need to assess how agents respond to persuasive malicious requests.

papers.title_en: SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots
papers.authors: Deepali Mittal, Dheeraj Mundhra, Yulia Sidorova, Tersia de Kock, Oli Munns, Sofie S Meyer
papers.evidence: 用模拟且贴近真实的多轮用户行为评估分诊聊天机器人
papers.tldr: 医疗分诊聊天机器人常以单轮英语知识题评估，难以覆盖真实用户的多语言表达与多轮互动。SIM-UT依据用户画像、沟通方式和现实约束，模拟对话并迭代评测三国的健康聊天机器人。在逾5000轮对话中，医学微调模型与通用前沿模型均出现危险的降级处置：用户淡化症状后，即使没有新增临床信息，模型也可能撤回紧急就医建议。研究说明，分诊安全评估应关注跨轮次行为，而不只是医学知识正确率。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots' knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. We compared a medically fine-tuned open model (MedGemma) against general-purpose frontier models (ChatGPT and Claude) across 5,000+ multilingual simulated conversation turns grounded in the personas, constraints, and communication patterns of the real user populations, over 2-4 iterative rounds. A key failure mode emerged in both model families: de-escalation risk. The agents initially identified medical emergencies correctly, but when the user minimised the symptoms without introducing new clinical information, they de-escalated, exhibiting clinically dangerous sycophancy, for example agreeing that vaginal bleeding in pregnancy was "not a problem" or that decreased fetal movements at 32 weeks "can be normal". We recommend user simulation-based behavioural evaluation, grounded in real user context and covering adversarial and edge cases, as standard practice for triage chatbots in production, so that safeguards can be added before deployment or in subsequent iterations.

papers.title_en: Metacognitive Scaffolds Create Productive Friction for AI-Assisted Knowledge Work
papers.authors: Viktor Kewenig, Lev Tankelevitch, Sean Rintel, Advait Sarkar, Abigail Sellen
papers.evidence: 实验检验认知支架如何影响人机协作与知识工作
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能使知识工作从内容生产转向规划、评估与统筹，也提高了对元认知能力的要求。研究通过297名工作者、594篇文章的随机组间实验，检验动态生成的目标明确与任务分解支架。支架提升了写作质量，移除后短期内优势仍在，并有证据表明三天后的主题回忆有所改善。然而，参与者认为人工智能更费脑、帮助更少，提示有益的认知摩擦可能促进表现与学习，不能仅以主观轻松程度评价工具价值。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI imposes new metacognitive demands on knowledge workers as their work shifts from production to planning, evaluation, and orchestration. In a randomized, between-subjects experiment on AI-assisted writing (297 workers, 594 essays), we test dynamically-generated metacognitive scaffolds supporting goal specification and task decomposition. We find that scaffolds improve writing quality, with this boost persisting in short-lag transfer when scaffolds are removed. We also find evidence of improved topic recall three days later. These effects are consistent with observed changes in how people learn to prompt AI systems after exposure to scaffolding. However, scaffolded participants rate the AI as less helpful and more cognitively demanding even as they perform better, suggesting that subjective ease can understate the value of support. Our findings make the case for metacognitive scaffolds in AI-assisted knowledge work, revealing a productive friction worth designing for as workers increasingly delegate work to agentic AI.

papers.title_en: Towards User Simulators That Stay On Task And Still Sound Natural
papers.authors: Mustafa Omer Gul, Philippe Laban, Tanya Goyal, Jennifer Neville
papers.evidence: 构建自然且遵循用户意图的模拟器，用于评估多轮助理交互。
papers.tldr: 长程多轮交互需要可靠的用户模拟器，但现有方法难以兼顾复杂意图执行与自然对话行为：提示式助手较忠于任务，专用模拟器则更自然却容易偏离目标。论文提出联合奖励任务意图遵循和行为自然度的强化学习方案，并让轻量判别器与模拟器交替对抗训练。所得模型UserLM-2.0的有效模拟对话比例达46.2%，超过最强既有模拟器14.1%的三倍。该方法为评估和改进长程交互助手提供了更可靠的模拟用户。
papers.abstract_en: Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. We release the resulting model, UserLM-2.0, which produces valid simulated conversations (i.e., meeting both task-faithfulness and naturalness criteria) 46.2% of the time, over three times the rate of the strongest prior user simulator (14.1%).

papers.title_en: Digital Nudge Effects in Optimal Stopping Games: Antagonistic Interactions in Layered Choice Architectures
papers.authors: Batisse Manhardt, Ja-Nae Duane
papers.evidence: 通过对照用户实验评估多种数字助推对选择行为及结果的影响。
papers.tldr: 数字界面常叠加多种助推，但它们会相互增强还是抵消，仍缺乏实验证据。研究以秘书问题为序贯决策任务，对181名参与者开展三因素、八条件组间实验，比较锚定、显著性和社会认同助推。结果显示，锚定反而增加探索，显著性助推效应最小；锚定与社会认同组合的结果质量最差，且助推数量越多，结果质量越低。研究为数字助推的挤出效应提供受控实验证据，提示界面设计不能假定助推叠加必然有益。
papers.abstract_en: Digital nudges have become a prominent area of research in human-centered interaction, yet little is known about how they interact when deployed together. This study examines the individual and combined effects of anchoring, salience, and social proof digital nudges on stopping behavior and outcome quality in a sequential decision task. Using a 2^3 between-subjects factorial design grounded in the secretary problem (N = 181), we find that (1) an anchor nudge significantly increased exploration rather than constraining it (b = 1.207, p = .017); (2) the salience nudge produced the smallest effect of any condition; and (3) combining the anchor and social proof nudges produced the worst outcome quality of any condition ($181.83 vs. $192.21 for anchor-only), with outcome quality declining monotonically as nudge count increased. These findings provide the first controlled evidence for a digital nudge crowding-out effect with direct implications for the ethical design of digital interfaces.

papers.title_en: Touch-JEPA: Tactile Representation Learning from Hand-Object Video with Limited Tactile Supervision
papers.authors: Minseong Kweon, Qiao Feng, Yiming Huang, Lingjie Liu
papers.evidence: 从手物交互视频学习触觉表征，支持接触理解与触摸交互。
papers.tldr: 触觉测量成本高、覆盖有限，制约了手物交互中接触状态与触觉强度的表征学习。Touch-JEPA利用视频推导的手部几何，从时空上下文预测手表面对应位置被遮蔽的视觉特征，并可结合少量触觉标注联合训练。仅经自监督预训练的冻结特征，配合简单监督读出，即在三个人手基准上优于监督基线，还能迁移至未提供触觉训练数据的机器人手。研究表明，手物视频可提供可扩展的触觉学习信号，少量实测数据则补充物理约束。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding contact and tactile magnitude in hand-object interaction is a key step toward physically intelligent systems, yet learning such representations is limited by the cost and restricted coverage of tactile measurements. We present Touch-JEPA, a framework for learning tactile representations from hand-object videos with limited tactile supervision. We first introduce a self-supervised pretraining objective that learns from video alone without tactile supervision. Using video-derived hand geometry, Touch-JEPA predicts masked visual features at corresponding hand-surface locations from spatial and temporal context, encouraging the representation to capture latent contact dynamics. We then extend this formulation to joint representation learning, where masked prediction is applied to all videos while tactile supervision is available only for a labeled subset, grounding the shared representation in measured contact and magnitude. With self-supervised pretraining alone, simple supervised readouts on frozen Touch-JEPA features outperform supervised baselines in contact discrimination and tactile magnitude estimation across three human-hand benchmarks, and transfer to robotic hands without robot tactile training data. Joint learning with limited tactile supervision further improves contact and magnitude estimation on the human-hand benchmarks. Together, these results show that hand-object video can provide scalable self-supervision for tactile representation learning, while limited tactile measurements provide complementary physical grounding.

papers.title_en: A Three-Pillar Governance Framework for Safe and Trustworthy AI Agents
papers.authors: Edward C. Cheng, Jeshua Cheng, Alice Siu
papers.evidence: 提出以结构化人工监督、问责和运行控制为核心的智能体治理框架。
papers.tldr: 自主决策型智能体带来安全、意图对齐、责任归属与人类监督难题，现有方法在系统设计、治理和部署之间仍较分散。论文提出以透明性、问责性和可信赖性为三大支柱的治理框架，通过渐进验证、结构化人类监督及可审计的运行控制，逐步提高智能体自主程度。框架将生命周期监测、决策追溯、升级处置与人机协作纳入统一治理路径。其贡献是为企业智能体的受控部署提供操作基础，但摘要未报告量化实验验证。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making introduce significant challenges related to safety, alignment, accountability, and human oversight. Existing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and responsible AI approaches provide important foundations, but many remain fragmented across system design, governance, and operational deployment. This paper presents a Three-Pillar (3P) model and framework for developing safe and trustworthy AI agents through transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness. The framework defines an evolutionary path in which increasing agent autonomy is introduced through progressive validation, structured human oversight, and auditable operational controls. We further describe how the model supports agent lifecycle monitoring, decision traceability, escalation management, and human-agent collaboration within enterprise agentic environments. By integrating oversight principles with operational mechanisms, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for deploying AI agents that remain aligned with human intent while enabling controlled progression toward higher autonomy.

papers.title_en: Anticipating Social Consequences with Distributional World Models
papers.authors: Viet-Thanh Pham, Thuy-Trang Vu, Zhuang Li, Lizhen Qu, Gholamreza Haffari
papers.evidence: 预测多种社会互动后果，支持智能体协商、合作与调解。
papers.tldr: 社会交互中，同一行动可能引发多种后续反应；只预测单一未来容易遗漏重要后果，反复模拟则增加推理成本。论文提出分布式社会世界模型DSWM，用一次输出给出每个候选行动的多种回应、概率及即时与最终结果价值，并以监督微调和GRPO训练40亿参数模型。在三个已见和两个未见环境中，模型在15项指标中的13项取得最佳平均表现。消融显示，多未来及其概率在五个环境中均有助益，为兼顾决策质量与推理开销提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Social world models predict how interactions develop after an action, helping agents negotiate, cooperate and mediate. In these situations, one action can lead to several plausible futures, hence predicting only one future can overlook consequential alternatives, while exploring them through repeated simulations increases inference cost. We propose DSWM, a Distributional Social World Model that predicts alternative responses, their probabilities and immediate and final outcome values in one output per candidate action. We train a 4B model on repeated simulations using supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. At inference time, the actor uses these possible consequences to choose an action. Across three seen and two unseen environments, with interaction backbones absent from training collection, DSWM achieves the best average performance on 13 of 15 metrics. Ablations show that retaining multiple futures and their predicted probabilities improves outcomes in all five environments.

papers.title_en: The Delegation Divide: An Open Index of AI-Agent Delegability across Occupations and Countries
papers.authors: Cristian Espinal Maya, Santiago Jiménez Londoño
papers.evidence: 量化不同国家和职业中可委托给AI智能体的工作任务
papers.tldr: 现有人工智能职业指标多衡量美国岗位的技术暴露，难以回答任务能否交给智能体。研究用两个语言模型评估18796项职业任务，构建智能体可委托指数，并按146国就业结构加权。结果显示，全球35.2%的工作任务时间至少可部分委托，但仅2.5%可完全交付；高收入国家的可委托比例明显更高，主要源于职业构成差异。该指数补充了委托等级与障碍信息，而非提供全新的职业排名，也不直接代表岗位替代率。
papers.abstract_en: 35.2% of task time in world employment is at least partly delegable to AI agents in 2026, and only 2.5% can be handed over in full. Existing measures score exposure to generative AI, mostly for the United States. We build the Agent Delegability Index (ADI): two language models rate all 18,796 O*NET 30.2 task statements on a frozen, preregistered rubric of delegation levels and barriers; tasks are mapped to 433 ISCO-08 unit groups and weighted by ILOSTAT employment in 146 countries. Four findings. First, delegable employment rises with income, from 22.5% in low-income to 48.7% in high-income countries, a slope of 7.23 percentage points per log point of GDP per capita. This delegation divide is compositional: the physical barrier dominates the jobs poorer countries employ most. Second, at the occupation level ADI tracks exposure closely (r = 0.93 with Eloundou et al. and 0.89 with Felten et al.), above the preregistered bound of 0.80; ADI adds delegation levels and barriers on top of exposure, for the world, not a new ranking of occupations. Third, full delegation is rare and peaks for tasks that take a human about twelve minutes (11.8 minutes). Fourth, the preregistered adoption gap is not supported: across 101 countries, delegability and observed AI usage correlate at r = 0.86, and the gap between them is not wider in middle-income countries (p = 0.27). Model agreement is kappa = 0.77; a blind human rating of 300 tasks agrees with the model consensus at kappa = 0.85, and an agentic panel with web search at kappa = 0.87. We release the index, the atlas, the prompts and an MCP server at https://github.com/Cespial/delegation-divide.

papers.title_en: ColaBench: Evaluating Memory-Guided Knowledge Acquisition in Personal Agents
papers.authors: Wenjie Zhang, Zhichao Shi, Xuhui Jiang, Xiaojun Wu, Cehao Yang, Chengjin Xu, Xiaoning Song
papers.evidence: 评测个人智能体如何利用长期历史获取并应用适合用户的知识
papers.tldr: 个人智能体即使检索到相关文档，也可能因忽略用户历史处境而给出不适用建议。ColaBench以健康与日常生活为场景，构建覆盖10类用户档案、349项任务和13033篇文档的合成基准，通过证据图关联个人条件、历史披露与答案依据。配套方法MemKB利用状态摘要和记忆—文档链接指导检索及规则应用，准确率达86.25%，每任务平均交互4.07轮。该工作为联合评估记忆引导的知识获取与个性化应用提供了可追溯框架。
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents need to draw on long-term interaction history to retrieve and apply external knowledge suited to a user's current request. Even an answer grounded in relevant documents can be unsuitable when it overlooks the user's circumstances. This creates two connected challenges: using historical conditions to identify the knowledge needed for a new request, and applying that knowledge to the user's situation. Existing benchmarks advance memory recall, personalized retrieval, and memory-guided action, while the joint evaluation of these two challenges remains underexplored. We introduce ColaBench, a synthetic benchmark in health and daily living, with 349 tasks across 10 Profiles and a knowledge base of 13,033 documents. Its Evidence Graph connects personal conditions to their disclosures across public interaction sessions, records prior document exposure, and links answer requirements to personal and newly acquired document evidence. We also introduce MemKB, which uses state summaries to inform queries and rule application, and memory-document links to retrieve knowledge associated with the user's history. MemKB achieves 86.25% Accuracy with an average of 4.07 interaction rounds per task. Task-level analysis finds larger gains on tasks integrating information across multiple historical Facts; error analysis further identifies unsupported personal assumptions and rule misapplication as obstacles to using retrieved evidence. ColaBench provides traceable tasks and an evaluation framework for studying how memory guides knowledge acquisition and rule application.

papers.title_en: Multi-Tool Selection for Robotic Systems: Comparing Semantic Retrieval and LLM
papers.authors: Miguel Sousa, Luis Ramos Pinto, João P. Matos-Carvalho
papers.evidence: 研究通过工具路由实现自然语言操控机器人系统
papers.tldr: 机器人自然语言接口需要选出满足指令的最小完整工具集，复合指令尤其容易漏选感知、监测能力或引入无关工具。论文比较三种逐步改进的语义检索策略与一个云端千亿参数语言模型。在164条人工标注指令上，分句感知检索的宏平均综合得分为0.7822，低于大模型的0.8869，但延迟显著更低且支持本地部署。研究揭示了工具路由质量与延迟的权衡，为隐私敏感、弱联网和资源受限机器人提供选型依据。
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language interfaces allow users to command robotic systems without interacting directly with mission planners or robotics middleware. Their reliable use depends on robot tool routing, defined here as the selection of the smallest complete subset of predefined executable capabilities required to satisfy a request. This task is particularly difficult for compound instructions, where incomplete selection may omit necessary sensing or monitoring capabilities, while excessive selection may expose irrelevant tools. We compare four routing strategies: three progressively refined ChromaDB-based methods - fixed-threshold retrieval, relative-distance retrieval, and clause-aware aggregated retrieval - and a cloud-hosted 120-billion-parameter language-model baseline. The methods are evaluated on 164 manually annotated prompts organised into three complexity levels, from direct single-tool requests to compound requests requiring at least three tools. Using exact-match accuracy, completeness, precision, a completeness-weighted composite score, and routing latency, CDB-v3 achieves the best macro-average score among the retrieval-only methods, with 0.7822, compared with 0.8869 for the large-model baseline. Although the LLM provides higher routing quality, CDB-v3 exhibits substantially lower latency and can be deployed locally without requiring cloud connectivity. These results identify a quality-latency trade-off between direct large-model selection and clause-aware semantic retrieval for privacy-sensitive, connectivity-constrained, and resource-constrained robotic systems.

papers.title_en: "Can Computing Systems Eventually Disappear?": A Long-Term Tracking Study on the Use of Diabetes Computing Systems by Patients with Diabetes
papers.authors: Yibo Meng, Jinyuan Zhan, Yao Lyu, Zhuoran Lu, Chengxi Zang
papers.evidence: 纵向研究患者对日益自动化健康系统的体验
papers.tldr: 糖尿病计算系统日益自动化，但技术融入日常后，是否会削弱患者的主动判断仍不清楚。研究于2017—2025年对37名患者开展五轮纵向访谈，并访谈15名临床医生、设计师与供应商，考察三代设备的长期使用。研究发现“持续使用但认知脱离”：患者仍使用设备，却逐渐减少解释与质疑，转而主要响应警报。功能扩张、解释权委托和信息疲劳促成这一状态，提示系统应在减轻负担的同时保留患者理解、联系情境和质疑输出的机会。
papers.abstract_en: Ubiquitous computing has long pursued Weiser's vision of technologies that "disappear" into everyday life. As wearable health systems advance, they increasingly substitute for rather than scaffold users' judgment, yet the long-term consequences remain underexplored. We report an eight-year, five-wave longitudinal interview study from 2017 to 2025 with 37 patients with diabetes, complemented by interviews with 15 clinicians, designers, and vendors. Across three technological generations including glucometers, continuous glucose monitoring, and predictive and automated insulin delivery systems, we identify a novel user state, continued use with cognitive disengagement. In this state, devices remain in use but active interpretation and questioning recede, leaving users to respond only to alarms. This state emerges from functional expansion, delegation of interpretive authority, and information fatigue, and is reinforced by clinical prioritization, information compression, and automation. It results in less frequent independent health judgment and a shift from understanding to responding. We argue that future diabetes computing systems should reduce unnecessary cognitive work while preserving users' opportunities to interpret, contextualize, and question system outputs.

papers.title_en: Vulnerability Analysis for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement
papers.authors: Taozheng Zhu, Shixiong Jiang, Fanxin Kong
papers.evidence: 研究合作式多智能体强化学习中的安全脆弱性。
papers.tldr: 安全多智能体强化学习虽在训练中约束安全，却缺少对推理阶段观测攻击的系统评估。论文提出MinMax Attack，联合选择受控智能体的对抗目标动作，并考虑正常智能体的协作抵抗，同时推导安全代价界及其与受控智能体数量、扰动预算的关系。多项安全关键基准实验表明，该方法比已有攻击显著提高安全代价，同时保持任务奖励。这揭示了任务表现正常并不意味着系统安全，也凸显了安全策略的对抗鲁棒性缺口。
papers.abstract_en: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SMARL) aims to learn cooperative control policies under prescribed safety constraints. Al- though existing SMARL methods focus on enforcing safety during policy optimization, their vulnerability remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates inference-time observation attacks against SMARL, where an adversary perturbs the observations of a subset of agents, thereby altering the actions produced by their policies. We propose MinMax Attack, an attack framework that jointly selects adversarial target actions for compromised agents while accounting for the Cooperative Resistance of benign agents. We further derive a bound on the induced safety cost and characterize its relation- ship with the Compromised-Agent Budget and the Perturbation Budget. Experiments across multiple safety-critical multi-agent benchmarks and representative state-of-the-art SMARL algorithms show that MinMax Attack induces substantially higher safety costs than existing attack baselines while preserving task reward, thereby reducing its detectability and achieving both attack effectiveness and stealthiness.

papers.title_en: MERP: A Latent-Bottleneck Framework for Robust Multi-Modal Multi-Label Emotion Recognition
papers.authors: Chuangxin Zhao, Meimei Zhang, Canran Xiao, Jiachen Luo, Jiajun He, Kaijie Chen, Huy Phan, Tomoki Toda, Biörn W. Schuller
papers.evidence: 面向情感感知系统的稳健多模态情绪识别
papers.tldr: 多模态多标签情绪识别模型在完整模态上训练，却常因部署时文本、视觉或音频缺失而显著退化。MERP将可用模态压缩至固定规模潜变量库，结合标签证据重建、类别原型、噪声增强与置信度融合，提高缺失模态鲁棒性。测试随机丢弃20%模态时，其在两个数据集上的微平均F1分别为0.563和0.780；仅音频条件下也明显优于所比较方法。该框架无需缺失模态训练样本，为稳健情绪识别提供了可验证路径。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal multi-label emotion recognition is important for affect-aware systems, but models trained with complete text, visual, and acoustic streams often degrade sharply when some streams are unavailable at deployment. We address this train-test gap by learning a compact representation that preserves emotion-specific evidence from any available subset of modalities. We propose the Multi-modal Emotion Recognition Perceiver (MERP), which maps the joint sequence into a fixed-size latent bank, thereby keeping repeated reasoning independent of raw input length; it extracts label-specific evidence before and after latent reasoning and aligns the two levels through reconstruction. MERP further uses positive and negative class prototypes, a noise-gated feature enhancer with frequency-shaped perturbations during training, and confidence-aware class-wise fusion to strengthen separability, reduce sensitivity to missing inputs, and combine complementary predictors. Under 20 percent test-time random modality drop, MERP achieves micro-F1 scores of 0.563 on CMU-MOSEI and 0.780 on M3ED, exceeding the strongest evaluated baselines by 0.004 and 0.005, respectively; in the severe CMU-MOSEI audio-only setting, it retains 0.473 micro-F1 versus 0.022 for LDDU. These results show that fixed latent reasoning provides a practical, testable route to robust multimodal emotion recognition without requiring missing-modality examples during training. Code is available at https://github.com/Creative-zcx/MERP.

papers.title_en: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
papers.authors: Nithin Sivakumaran, Ali Payani, Hyunji Lee, Mohit Bansal, Elias Stengel-Eskin
papers.evidence: 通过心智理论推理提升多个智能体之间的协作协调。
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作需要推断伙伴的信念与意图，但文本推理难以同时表达多种可能状态。ToM2Vec以固定数量的连续推理令牌，在潜在空间中学习伙伴心智表征，并用伙伴实际思考进行训练监督。在协作、竞争及混合动机场景中，该方法持续优于基础模型和多类基线，且能泛化至未见伙伴模型。改用文本推理会降低性能，令牌也能改善伙伴心智问答，为连续表征支持多智能体协调提供证据。
papers.abstract_en: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.

papers.title_en: When Agentic Retrieval Fails Silently: Framework and Production Evidence from a Creative AI Assistant
papers.authors: Yan, Liang, Anuj Agarwal, Aditya Reddy Cheruku
papers.evidence: 评估AI助手的检索、参与度、结果与产品成效
papers.tldr: 智能体助手先由生成层消费检索结果，用户行为又可能跨轮次或会话发生，使传统点击与排序指标难以归因检索质量。论文提出分层智能体检索评估框架LARA，将检索质量、参与及结果、产品成功独立衡量，并以四字段溯源结构连接。Adobe Express数据显示，聊天端改写率为44.4%，高于图库端的33.1%，但聊天改写用于细化生成结果，不能直接视为检索失败。该框架无需新增建模，为智能体检索提供更清晰的评估与归因路径。
papers.abstract_en: CTR, MRR, and behavioral NDCG assume the user sees ranked results and acts on them. In an agentic assistant, a generation layer consumes retrieval output first, and that assumption breaks in three ways. The agent reads the results before the user does (who). The user's action can come several turns or sessions after retrieval (when). Outcomes blend retrieved content with the model's own knowledge (what caused it). We call this the attribution gap. We propose Layered Agentic Retrieval Assessment (LARA), which measures retrieval quality, engagement and outcome, and product success as three independent layers joined by a four-field lineage schema that requires no new modeling. We examine the motivation on Adobe Express, where one retrieval infrastructure serves a gallery search surface and an agentic assistant at roughly one-eighth its session volume for the same user population. Chat users reformulate more than gallery users (44.4% vs. 33.1%) because chat reformulation refines generated output. LARA restores attribution for the retrieval.

papers.title_en: SpecMAGIC: Specification-Guided Multi-Task Generalization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Zijian Guo, İlker Işık, H. M. Sabbir Ahmad, Wenchao Li
papers.evidence: 提出分层多智能体强化学习，以协调多个任务中的智能体
papers.tldr: 多智能体强化学习难以泛化到具有复杂时序与不同协作要求的新任务。SpecMAGIC将时序逻辑与协作约束结合为任务规范，利用自动机分解子任务，由集中式规划器分配兼容的子任务序列，再由分散式策略执行。该方法无需重新训练即可组合已有策略，导航实验显示其在未见规范上优于现有方法，且随智能体数量增加仍保持较强表现。研究还证明了高层规划器的可靠性与概率完备性，为多智能体任务的零样本组合泛化提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task generalization is an important yet underexplored problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Many real-world applications require multi-agent systems to generalize across complex, temporally extended tasks with diverse inter-agent coordination requirements. We introduce a specification language that combines temporal-logic task specifications with operators for expressing such requirements. We propose SpecMAGIC, a hierarchical framework that leverages the automaton structure of task specifications for subtask decomposition. A centralized high-level planner identifies and allocates compatible subtask sequences across agents, while decentralized low-level policies execute individual subtasks. This enables zero-shot generalization to new tasks by composing reusable subtask policies according to new specifications, without retraining. We establish soundness and probabilistic completeness of the high-level planner. Experiments on multi-agent navigation tasks show that SpecMAGIC substantially outperforms existing approaches on unseen task specifications and maintains strong performance as the number of agents increases.

papers.title_en: Your Home Remembers: A Voice-Enabled Household Memory Assistant for Conversational Retrieval
papers.authors: Aleix Sant, Jordi Luque, Fernando López, Pablo Gómez, Carlos Escolano
papers.evidence: 语音助理保存对话信息并支持后续检索
papers.tldr: 家庭中的用药说明、约定和物品位置常只在交谈中出现，事后容易遗忘。论文提出运行于安卓平板的语音家庭记忆助手，将录音转写、说话人分离及带时间戳的对话片段接入向量检索，再通过检索增强生成回答问题。系统支持免手操作、历史与新近语音检索，以及答案来源查看；摘要未报告定量评测。其贡献在于把家庭对话转化为可追溯的记忆，并通过模块化架构支持语音与语言模型替换。
papers.abstract_en: Everyday household information is often exchanged in conversations but never written down, making details easy to forget or misremember. We present a voice-enabled smart-home assistant that acts as a household memory by recording conversations and retrieving information from stored and newly captured speech. The assistant runs on an Android tablet with a modular architecture in which speech-recognition, diarisation, embedding and language models can be configured or replaced through an orchestration layer. On-device wake-word detection and VAD-based query capture support hands-free interaction. Recorded audio is processed in configurable chunks, transcribed and diarised, converted into turn-aware passages with conversation-level timestamps, and indexed in a vector store. For memory queries, a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline selects key passages and uses them to generate an answer. The interface supports recording, conversation management and inspection of timestamped sources.

papers.title_en: Same Context, Different Agents: A Behavioral Study of Semantic Layers, Orchestration and Compaction in Data Agents
papers.authors: Zhivar Sourati, Marianne Menglin Liu, Zheng Wang, Rongguang Wang, Sai Ashish Somayajula, Tao Sheng, Kyu J. Han, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth
papers.evidence: 研究智能体编排与交互历史压缩如何影响长程任务执行
papers.tldr: 异构数据问答依赖上下文，但相同的上下文工程技术未必适合所有数据智能体。研究在七种大语言模型、五个基准的1514项长程任务上，评估语义层、多智能体编排与历史压缩及其组合。结果发现，智能体分为调查型、过早作答型和提前放弃型，技术收益只有匹配行为类型时才转化为准确率提升；编排反而使调查型准确率下降五个百分点。研究表明，上下文工程并非越多越好，应结合行为、任务需求与成本选择。
papers.abstract_en: Answering questions over heterogeneous data means combining evidence from files, databases, documents and the web. Data agents automate this, but their success depends on context. Three context-engineering techniques (CETs) help by shaping it: semantic layers describe the data, orchestration splits work among agents, and compaction condenses interaction history. Existing studies validate each CET alone, leaving open how agent behavior shapes its effect. We present a comprehensive analysis of the three CETs, alone and combined, with seven large language models (LLMs) on 1,514 long-horizon tasks from five benchmarks, covering behavior, accuracy and cost. We find that data agents without CETs form three behavior groups: investigators, premature answerers that answer without inspecting data, and early stoppers that give up. Each CET delivers its known benefit, from more investigation to smaller prompts, but only the behavior group it matches turns that benefit into accuracy, such as premature answerers under orchestration. For investigators, the same CETs can hurt: the semantic layer stops them from looking, orchestration makes them overconfident, costing 5 percentage points, and compaction makes them repeat steps. Combining CETs yields smaller gains and losses than their sum. We derive guidance for choosing CETs by agent behavior, task demands and accuracy-cost trade-offs.

papers.title_en: Learning Rewards in Strategic Games
papers.authors: Antoine Bergerault, Cyrille Kone, Giorgia Ramponi
papers.evidence: 以逆强化学习推断战略多智能体互动中的奖励
papers.tldr: 战略环境中，能解释既有行为的奖励未必能支持可靠决策，仅增加固定策略下的观测样本也可能无法解决这一问题。论文以战略可识别性刻画该局限，并针对双人重复斯塔克尔伯格博弈提出主动逆强化学习，让领导者调整策略以探测跟随者奖励。方法结合最大似然估计与实验设计，使下游策略次优性达到忽略多对数因子的最小最大最优速率。反偷猎实验进一步验证了主动探索对奖励恢复和战略表现的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the objectives that drive agents' behavior is crucial in strategic environments, where multiple agents interact and adapt to one another. This challenge arises in domains such as cybersecurity, autonomous driving, and online markets, where agents' underlying incentives are typically unknown and must be inferred from their observed behavior. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a natural framework for this problem, but extending IRL to strategic multi-agent settings introduces a fundamental challenge: a reward that explains observed behavior does not necessarily induce optimal strategies when used for decision-making. In this work, we study this problem through the lens of \emph{strategic identifiability}, and show that learning from a fixed policy pair can be insufficient to strategically identify rewards, independent of the number of expert samples $K$. Motivated by this, we introduce an active IRL algorithm for two-player repeated Stackelberg games, in which the leader adaptively selects policies to elicit informative responses about the follower's reward. Combining maximum-likelihood estimation with experimental design, we derive finite-sample guarantees on the Stackelberg sub-optimality induced by the learned reward, matching up to polylogarithmic factors a new minimax learning rate of $K^{-1/2}$. Finally, we evaluate our approach in a realistic anti-poaching setting, demonstrating the benefits of active exploration for reward recovery and downstream strategic performance.

papers.title_en: PremiseSQL: Evaluating Premise Critique and Abstention in Text-to-SQL Systems
papers.authors: Shuo Lin, Jinzhe Li, Chenlu Guo, Yanhan Li, Yuan Wu, Yi Chang
papers.evidence: 评估系统能否识别用户查询的问题并选择拒答
papers.tldr: 现有文本转SQL系统通常默认用户问题有效，即使前提有误，也可能生成可执行却具有误导性的SQL。论文提出“前提批判能力”，构建包含1800条错误前提查询及1800条对应原始查询的PremiseSQL基准，覆盖四类前提缺陷，并在三种提示设置下评估模型表现。实验发现，前沿大模型默认倾向于相信前提；强化批判提示虽能改善错误识别与拒答，却也增加对原始查询的误判。研究揭示了可靠拒答与正常生成之间的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL performance, yet existing NL2SQL systems largely assume that user queries are valid and answerable. As a result, models often generate executable SQL even for queries with flawed premises. We introduce premise critique ability in NL2SQL, namely the ability to recognize flawed queries and abstain from generating misleading SQL. To evaluate this capability, we propose PremiseSQL, a benchmark containing 1,800 flawed NL2SQL queries across four categories of premise failures, along with their 1,800 original queries. We further design an evaluation framework to measure intrinsic and prompt-induced premise-aware behavior across three prompting settings. Experiments on frontier LLMs show that current models are strongly premise-trusting by default and rarely critique flawed premises. Stronger critique-oriented prompting improves detection and abstention on flawed queries, but also increases false invalid judgments and suppresses SQL generation on originals. The code is available at https://github.com/vegeet/PremiseSQL.

papers.title_en: When Ubiquitous Health Data Stops Helping: Patients' Experience of Breakdowns in the Data-Interpretation-Action Loop at the End of Life
papers.authors: Yibo Meng, Xinru Wang, Zhuoyan Li, Chengxi Zang, Zhuoran Lu, Zhicong Lu
papers.evidence: 访谈患者如何理解并应对算法健康数据
papers.tldr: 泛在健康系统常假设数据越可见，患者越能理解病情并采取行动，但这一逻辑在临终照护中可能失效。研究通过访谈25名终末期患者和8名临床人员，分析患者接触、解释、使用及退出健康数据的经历。结果发现，缺乏解释路径、行动建议与身体能力及照护目标错位，以及难以摆脱数据暴露，构成三类反复出现的断裂。研究据此提出，应减少不必要的数据暴露，支持稳定理解、照护情境适配及生命意义层面的关怀。
papers.abstract_en: Ubiquitous computing systems in healthcare often assume that greater data visibility improves awareness, interpretation, and action. In end-of-life care, however, this assumption warrants scrutiny. Through semi-structured interviews with 25 terminal-stage patients as primary informants and 8 clinicians as supplementary informants, we examine patients' descriptions of how they encountered, interpreted, acted on, and disengaged from state signals, trajectories, algorithmic outputs, and behavioral audits. Our analysis identifies three recurrent patterns in these descriptions. First, participants described repeated and unresolved sensemaking when visible data lacked explanatory pathways. Second, they described outputs they could understand but whose suggested actions did not fit their changing bodily capacities, care goals, or decision-making roles. Third, they described difficulty disengaging when data remained embedded across care environments. Rather than rejecting data altogether, patients called for less data exposure and a reorientation toward existential support. Based on this analysis, we situate data exposure as a central interaction problem in end-of-life ubiquitous computing and derive design implications for interpretive stability, care-context alignment, and existential support.

papers.title_en: Modeling Group Socialization in Online Communities
papers.authors: Vinay Koshy, Iris Zhong, Karrie Karahalios, Benjamin Mako Hill, Amy X. Zhang
papers.evidence: 研究新人学习社区规范及社区的双向适应
papers.tldr: 在线社区的社会化通常被视为新人学习群体规范，但成员与社区也可能相互适应。论文提出双向语言社会化模型，将用户评论建模为群体内部语言与其先前参与社区语言的混合。在112个社区、780万词元的Reddit数据上，该模型跨用户和时间的预测泛化优于两种单向模型，并发现严格管理的小众社区及资深用户更趋同于群体规范。研究为双向社会化提供大规模实证支持，并提出可证伪的定量框架。
papers.abstract_en: Newcomers to online communities must learn a group's norms to participate successfully. This process is known as socialization, and has been the subject of considerable study in the online communities literature. Foundational work on group socialization in social psychology, however, suggests that socialization is actually a bidirectional process: individuals and communities adapt to each other's needs. In this work we develop a formal quantitative model of socialization, and present the first large scale empirical validation of the bidirectional socialization hypothesis using Reddit data. More specifically, we focus on linguistic socialization, and model users' comments in online communities as a mixture of in-group language and language from ``background'' communities they previously participated in. On a dataset of 112 subreddits (7.8 million tokens) find that our bidirectional model makes predictions that better generalize across users and time than two unidirectional socialization models. Furthermore, we conduct a qualitative analysis in which we demonstrate that our model is able to extract interpretable socialization patterns from the data that align with the existing literature. Specifically our model is able to learn that users conform more to group norms in topically niche communities with stricter content moderation rules, and that long time users conform more than newcomers. We emphasize that the claims made in this paper are explicitly falsifiable -- we are staking out a clear claim about what the socialization process looks like, and encourage future work to challenge our model.

papers.title_en: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
papers.authors: Jiang Wu, Yutong Song, Hongbo Wang, Guanghe Cao, Jeff Liang
papers.evidence: 利用用户历史与反馈进行个性化推荐
papers.tldr: 语言模型能利用物品文本、用户历史和反馈进行个性化推荐，但逐一处理候选的完整文本会限制在线吞吐。DuoLM以编码器离线生成可复用的紧凑物品表示，再由个性化排序器结合用户信息评分，并通过推荐监督与教师蒸馏联合训练。配合嵌入访问、历史计算共享和CUDA Graph回放，单张H100每秒可完成约2.64万次候选评分，吞吐约为教师基线的60倍。其推荐质量与专家教师相当，展示了模型压缩与推理运行时协同优化的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about $60\times$ the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.
